subject: Pioneer AI — ask to prioritize a short-term feature lift for model residency
messages:
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-03T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Pioneer AI — short ask: prioritize model residency & warm pool for Q3 pilot

Hi Ben / Laura,

Quick background: Pioneer AI is at contract review and is asking for a short-term guarantee that their primary inference traffic (conversational routing, 12–15 req/s peak) can run on a pinned model residency for the first 6 weeks of the pilot to hit latency targets for demo day.

Why it matters: Pioneer will only go-live with the committed low latency (<=120ms p95) during demo week — they’ve tied this to an internal milestone and a marketing co-demo. If we can offer a temporary model-residency carveout (best-effort warm pool + KV pre-seeding) they will sign the SOW and commit to a 6-month Dedicated contract thereafter.

Ask: can Product/Eng prioritize a short-lived feature lift to 1) expose a residency-config that pins a model variant to a reserved pool, and 2) provide a small warm pool + pre-seed flow for session KV so first-token latency is stable?

Attachments: I included the current MAPP and draft SOW — see Pioneer_MAPP-v2.pdf / SOW-Pioneer-draft.docx.

I can take on coordination and comp. notes; Laura, can you weigh in on scope and ship risk? Ben, I’ll sync with Emily (Pioneer) to confirm non-prod demo window.

Thanks,
Connor
--
Connor O'Brien
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-03T11:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pioneer AI — short ask: prioritize model residency & warm pool for Q3 pilot

Connor / Ben,

Thanks for the heads-up. High level: the request is feasible but non-trivial. Two immediate concerns:

- Operational risk: pinning a model variant to a small capacity affects autoscaler behavior and could impact other customers if we don’t strictly isolate networking/quotas.
- Engineering effort: implementing an explicit "pin-to-pool" flag + a pre-seed KV flow is about a 3-week focused effort with one backend engineer + 0.5 product engineering support, assuming no changes to scheduling kernels. That’s optimistic.

If Pioneer is willing to accept a limited SLA (demo-week carveout: 99% availability, no extended latency SLA) and to sign the SOW quickly, we can push this as a Q3 micro-project.

Concrete next steps I propose:
1) Connor & Ben confirm the exact demo window and committed traffic shape.
2) Engineering to scope a minimal implementation (pin flag + TTL'd warm pool + simple pre-seed API). Priyom / Jasmine can own a spike.
3) Legal / Sales to finalize SOW language for the temporary carveout (timebound, safety valve).

Happy to join a 30-min sync after you lock timing.

Laura
--
Laura Bennett
Group PM, Product — Redwood Inference
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-03T13:28:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pioneer AI — short ask: prioritize model residency & warm pool for Q3 pilot

Laura / team,

I can take the spike for this. Notes from a quick pass:
- Pinning: simplest path is a scheduler-level tag that keeps X GPUs reserved and avoids preemption. That needs scheduler changes + account-level cap enforcement.
- Warm pool: we can reuse the warm-pool work from the onboarding pipeline, but we need an API to pre-seed KV for known session prefixes (we have existing pre-seed infra but not exposed).

Estimated minimal deliverable (MVP): 2 weeks of focused effort (1 eng full-time) for scheduler tag + pre-seed API + trigger; additional 1 week for testing + rollout. Risk: if we change eviction rules, we need canarying to avoid cross-tenant interference.

I’ll prepare a short tech note by EOD outlining the exact tasks and blockers. If Pioneer can provide a reproducible load shape and test tokens (they’ve offered to run a smoke script), that will reduce QA time.

Priyom
Senior Software Engineer — Serving Runtime
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Emily Tan <emily.tan@pioneer.ai>, Rajiv Menon <rajiv@pioneer.ai>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-03T16:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pioneer AI — short ask: prioritize model residency & warm pool for Q3 pilot

Emily / Rajiv,

Thanks again for the call earlier. Connor walked me through the SOW draft; Pioneer’s demo week is June 28–30 and the pilot window they want pinned capacity for is June 22–July 31 (6 weeks).

To be explicit on tradeoffs: Redwood can deliver a timebound residency + warm pre-seeding as a pilot if Pioneer signs the SOW by next Tuesday and accepts a limited carveout describing the non-production SLA during demo week. In return Pioneer commits to a minimum QTD Dedicated capacity conversion if the pilot meets latency targets.

Emily — can you confirm you’re able to sign the attached SOW (SOW-Pioneer-draft.docx) by 2026-06-09? If not, please indicate the blocker so we can surface alternatives.

Attachments: SOW-Pioneer-draft.docx (redlines requested). HubSpot deal: https://hubspot.company/deals/DEAL-9876

Best,
Ben
--
Ben Carter
Senior AE | Redwood Inference
From: Emily Tan <emily.tan@pioneer.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Cc: Rajiv Menon <rajiv@pioneer.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-04T15:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pioneer AI — short ask: prioritize model residency & warm pool for Q3 pilot

Ben / Connor / team,

Thanks — we can sign the draft SOW by 6/9 provided we have a clear implementation plan and a single point of contact on Eng for smoke testing. Rajiv will coordinate test tokens and a simple load script to simulate our demo traffic.

Two clarifying asks from Pioneer:
1) Can Redwood guarantee that the pinned capacity will not be preempted for scheduled maintenance during the demo window? We need a maintenance blackout for the pinned pool.
2) We need an API to query residency status and current warm-pool fill percentage so our platform can show realtime readiness.

If those are acceptable, we’ll sign and move legal. Please share the engineering spike note when ready.

Emily
Director, Platform Engineering — Pioneer AI
